blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Precise grounding matters. It specifies which object is the target and where that object is, even in clutter and for tiny objects, and it has to be fast enough for closed-loop control. Yet vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action models (WAMs) take perception from general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones, which still fail in these settings. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B grounding foundation model that generates points and boxes as quantized coordinates in a shared vocabulary. Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines. Against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI establishes a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). As a downstream visual backbone, GroundingPI improves performance on robotic manipulation and autonomous driving. On RoboTwin 2.0, it outperforms every mainstream backbone we evaluate in all four out-of-distribution settings, by up to 24.8% relative to the strongest backbone. On RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of the demonstrations outperforms those baselines trained with 75%. On nuScenes, used as the visual backbone, GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m. We systematically analyze GroundingPI’s pretraining in scale and data composition. Downstream autonomous driving and robotic manipulation improve as the pretraining is scaled. Analyzing the data recipe across these 11 perceptual capabilities shows dense grounding’s substantial benefits for both, and OCR’s potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. These results support grounding as a perceptual foundation, and dedicated perceptual pretraining as a promising direction for foundation models of physical intelligence.
blocks.zh: 精密地基事项. 它指定了哪个物体是目标,以及该物体的位置,即使是在杂乱无章的物体中和对于小物体来说,它必须足够快地进行闭路控制. 然而,视觉-语言行动(VLA)和世界行动模式(WAMS)从通用视觉-语言和视频生成的骨干中吸取了感知力,而这些在这样的环境下仍然失败. 我们引入了GroundingPI,一种4B的Grounding基础模型,它生成点和框作为共享词汇中的量化坐标. 培训将多式联运和空间预训、监督微调、强化学习与GPRO相结合,利用公共数据集和专用数据引擎的监督。 根据34个地面基准的44个基线,地面测量项目确定了新的技术水平,平均为73.68%,高于较大的GPT-6 Astra(71.54%)。 作为下游视觉骨干,GroundingPI改进了机器人操纵和自主驾驶的性能. 在RoboTwin 2.0上,它比我们评价的所有四个分配外环境的所有主流骨干都好,相对于最强的骨干而言,最高达24.8%. 在RoboCasa-GR1上,50%的示威活动都超过了75%的培训基线。 在作为视觉主干线的nuScenes上,GroundingPI平均实现0.296米的开球L2误差. 我们系统分析地表指数在规模和数据构成方面的预训。 随着预训规模的扩大,下游自主驾驶和机器人操纵得到了改进. 对这11种感知能力的数据配方进行分析,可以发现密集的地面对两者都有很大的好处,OCR作为感知学习的催化剂的潜力。 这些结果支持将认知基础作为基础,并专门进行认知前培训,作为身体智能基础模型的有希望的方向。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Visual grounding connects language to objects, locations, and interaction-relevant structures, making it a core perceptual capability of vision-language models (VLMs). Despite recent progress in grounding UI elements ( Lin et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) , regions ( Lai et al., 2024 ; Ren et al., 2024 ) , and task-relevant entities ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) , achieving broad and precise grounding for physical intelligence ( Black et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Kim et al., 2024 ) remains challenging.
blocks.zh: 视觉地面连接语言与对象,位置,以及互动相关的结构,使其成为视觉语言模型(VLM)的核心感知能力. 尽管最近在建立UI要素(Lin等人,2024年;Liu等人,2025年),区域(Lai等人,2024年;Ren等人,2024年),以及与任务有关的实体(Zhang等人,2023年;Jiang等人,2026年;Yu等人,2025年)方面有所进展,实现广泛而精确的物理智能基础(Black等人,2024年;Wang等人,2026年b年;Kim等人,2024年)仍然具有挑战性.

blocks.en: When tidying a cluttered desk, one finds the mug and its handle before deciding how to grasp and move it, establishing where to act before determining how to act . Vision-language-action (VLA) models ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) and world-action models (WAMs) ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) increasingly build on general-purpose vision-language and video-generation backbones. However, these backbones are not primarily optimized for the precise grounding required by physical interaction and leave perception as a bottleneck for downstream action learning.
blocks.zh: 当清理一个乱七八糟的桌子时,人们在决定如何抓住和移动之前,先找到这个杯子和它的手柄,然后确定如何采取行动。 视觉语言行动(VLA)模型(Kim等人,2024年;Black等人,2024年;NVIDIA等人,2025年)和世界行动模型(WAMS)(Kim等人,2026年;Ye等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年b)日益建立在通用视觉语言和视频生成的骨干上. 然而,这些骨干并没有主要为物理互动所需的精确地根进行优化,留下了作为下游动作学习瓶颈的感知.

blocks.en: Our evaluations reveal substantial weaknesses in general-purpose VLMs and considerable room for improvement in dedicated models such as Rex-Omni and LocateAnything ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . These limitations are particularly evident in demanding settings such as dense scenes and tiny objects, where Qwen3.5 models struggle and even GPT-6 Astra leaves room for improvement. Such perceptual gaps can leave scarce action data responsible for both perceptual and action learning. Compute and latency constraints further limit reliance on larger backbones for action execution ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . These gaps motivate building a more capable grounding foundation model.
blocks.zh: 我们的评价表明,在通用的VLM中存在重大弱点,在Rex-Omni和LocAnything等专用模型中还有相当大的改进余地(Jiang等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026a年)。 这些限制在要求很高的场合,如密集的场景和细小的物体中特别明显,其中Quen3.5模型挣扎,甚至GPT-6 Astra留下了改进的余地. 这种认知差距可能使很少的行动数据既负责认知,又负责行动学习。 计算和延迟制约进一步限制了对较大骨干执行的依赖(NVIDIA等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年b). 这些差距促使人们建立一个更有能力的基础模型。

blocks.en: Recent policy recipes already incorporate perceptual learning: the progression from π 0 \pi_{0} ( Black et al., 2024 ) to π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ) adds bounding-box prediction within a broader knowledge-insulation recipe ( Black et al., 2024 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Driess et al., 2025 ) , while other approaches introduce auxiliary modules and learning objectives to enhance perception ( Yu et al., 2026 ; Song et al., 2026 ; Tu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026c ) . We argue that a more natural and scalable approach is to develop strong grounding as a native capability of the foundation model. We pursue a grounding foundation model built on visual primitives, aiming to advance broad, precise perception and investigate its value for physical intelligence. We ask:
blocks.zh: 最近的政策配方已经包括了知觉学习:从 0\pi_{0}(Black等人,2024年)到π0.5\pi_{0.5}(Intelligence等人,2025年)在更广泛的知识隔绝食谱(Black等人,2024年;Intelligence等人,2025年;Driess等人,2025年)中增加了约束框预测,而其他方法则引入了辅助模块和学习目标,以提高知觉(Yu等人,2026年;Song等人,2026年;Tu等人,2026年;Chen等人,2026年c). 我们主张,一个更自然、更可扩展的方法是发展牢固的基础,作为基础模型的本土能力。 我们追求一个建立在视觉原始基础上的基础模型,目的是推进广泛,精确的认知,并调查它对物理智能的价值. 我们问:

blocks.en: Question 1: How far can we push the perceptual capabilities of grounding foundation models? Question 2: What does a stronger grounding foundation contribute to physical intelligence, and which grounding capabilities matter most? Question 3: What might these findings suggest about the design of future embodied foundation models?

blocks.en: Question 2: What does a stronger grounding foundation contribute to physical intelligence, and which grounding capabilities matter most?

blocks.en: To address these questions, we introduce GroundingPI , a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model for a broad range of perception tasks, built on visual primitives including points and bounding boxes. A shared vocabulary with quantized coordinates unifies diverse perception tasks as language-conditioned structured generation, covering grounding, referring, pointing, OCR, GUI and layout grounding, and visual prompting ( ). Training combines multimodal and spatial pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with GRPO, using supervision from public datasets and dedicated data engines.
blocks.zh: 为了解决这些问题,我们引入了GroundingPI(GroundingPI),这是用于一系列广泛感知任务的4B参数的地基模型,它建立在包括点和边框在内的视觉原始物上. 具有量化坐标的共享词汇统一了各种感知任务,作为语言条件结构化生成,涵盖地面,引用,指针,OCR,GUI和布局定位,以及视觉提示(.). 培训将多式联运和空间预训、监督微调、强化学习与GPRO相结合,利用公共数据集和专用数据引擎的监督。

blocks.en:
Evaluated against 44 baselines across 34 grounding benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, GroundingPI achieves 73.68% on average, establishing a new state of the art, averaging 73.68%, above the larger GPT-6 Astra (71.54%). We compare with GPT-6 Astra specifically to explore the potential and limits of improving basic perceptual performance. We further evaluate transfer to autonomous driving on nuScenes and robotic manipulation on RoboTwin 2.0 and RoboCasa-GR1. Within each manipulation benchmark, we fix the Action DiT, action data, and training budget. GroundingPI demonstrates strong transfer to physical intelligence tasks, consistently outperforming all evaluated mainstream backbones, in all four OOD settings, with relative improvements of up to 24.8% over the strongest baseline. Action-data efficiency also improves in robotic manipulation: on RoboCasa-GR1, GroundingPI trained with 50% of demonstrations outperforms all compared baselines trained with 75%.
These results support the value of a stronger perceptual foundation for downstream action learning.
blocks.zh:
根据34个地面基准的44个基线(涵盖11个感知能力)进行了评估,地面测量指数平均达到73.68%,创造了新的技术水平,平均达到73.68%,高于更大的GPT-6 Astra(71.54%)。 我们与GPT-6 Astra进行具体比较,以探索改善基本知觉性能的潜力和局限性. 我们进一步评价了RoboTwin 2.0和RoboCasa-GR1的自动驾驶和机器人操纵。 在每个操纵基准内,我们确定行动DiT,行动数据以及培训预算. 地面识别举措显示,在所有四个OO环境中,向物理情报任务转移的能力强,一直比所有被评价的主流骨干要强,相对比最强基线改善24.8%。 在机器人操纵方面,行动数据的效率也有所提高:在RoboCasa-GR1上,地面探测器培训了50%的演示效果,而培训的基线则比75%。
这些成果支持为下游行动学习奠定更牢固的认识基础的价值。

blocks.en: Our analyses offer insights into perceptual pretraining and the design of embodied foundation models. Scaling and data ablations show that both pretraining scale and data composition matter for grounding and downstream transfer. Basic grounding provides an important foundation, dense grounding substantially benefits autonomous driving and robotic manipulation, and OCR shows potential as a catalyst for perceptual learning. Our design insights focus on perceptual foundations for System-1-style execution ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . We discuss possible directions for designing such embodied foundation models to complement the high-level reasoning and planning of frontier models such as Astra. Visual primitives may further enable physical prompting, specifying targets, locations, and structures alongside language.
blocks.zh: 我们的分析使人们深入了解概念上的先期培训和设计体现的基本模式。 缩放和数据模拟表明,培训前规模和数据构成对地面和下游转移都很重要。 基本地面定位提供了一个重要的基础,密集地面定位极大地有利于自主驱动和机器人操纵,OCR显示出作为认知学习催化剂的潜力. 我们的设计见解侧重于System-1式处决的认知基础(NVIDIA等人,2025年;Chen等人,2026年b). 我们讨论了设计这种体现的基本模式的可能方向,以补充阿斯特拉等前沿模式的高级别推理和规划。 视觉原始人可能进一步促成物理提示,指定目标、位置和结构与语言并存。

blocks.en: In summary, our major contributions are as follows: • A strong grounding foundation model. We introduce GroundingPI, a 4B model built on visual primitives, with a staged training recipe and state-of-the-art grounding performance. • Transfer toward physical intelligence. Autonomous driving and robotic manipulation evaluations demonstrate the value of this perceptual foundation, including strong ID and OOD performance and improved action-data efficiency. • Insights into perceptual pretraining and future embodied paradigms. We analyze how pretraining scale and data composition shape grounding and transfer, and discuss implications for System-1 foundation-model design and its complementary role in future embodied systems.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Visual Grounding Models
blocks.zh: 2.1 视觉地面模型

blocks.en: Visual grounding has evolved from closed-set object detection ( Redmon et al., 2016 ; Carion et al., 2020 ) to language-conditioned localization beyond fixed vocabularies through grounded image-text pretraining ( Li et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . Generative grounding models adopt autoregressive next-token prediction to produce labels and quantized coordinates as structured sequences, providing a shared interface across diverse perception tasks ( Chen et al., 2022 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ; Jiang et al., 2026 ) , while LocateAnything explores precise grounding with parallel box decoding ( Jiang et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Spatial affordance prediction and spatial referring extend these capabilities toward robotic interaction ( Yuan et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . These advances motivate studying broad and precise grounding as a transferable perceptual foundation for physical intelligence.
blocks.zh: 视觉地面由闭塞定点物体检测(Redmon等人,2016年;Carion等人,2020年)演化为语言条件本地化,超越固定词汇,通过闭塞定点图像文字预训(Li等人,2022年;Liu等人,2024年). 基因地基模型采用自旋式下接式预测,以产生标签和定量坐标作为结构化序列,提供一个跨越不同感知任务的共享界面(Chen等人,2022年;Xiao等人,2024年;Jiang等人,2026年),而Lace Anything则探索用平行的箱解码进行精确地基(Jiang等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年a). 空间承受能力预测和空间参照将这些能力扩展到机器人相互作用(袁等人,2024年;周等人,2026年;吴等人,2026年)。 这些进步促使人们研究将广泛和精确的基础作为物理情报的可转移概念基础。

blocks.en: 2.2 Foundation Models for Physical Intelligence
blocks.zh: 2.2 物理情报基础模型

blocks.en: Physical-intelligence models increasingly inherit complementary priors from large-scale pretraining. VLA models build on VLMs to transfer broad visual-semantic knowledge and language grounding ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2024 ) , while WAMs adapt video and world models to leverage spatiotemporal and visual-dynamics priors ( Kim et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026b ) . Embodied foundation models further combine semantic, dynamic, and embodied experience toward more general physical intelligence ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Dang et al., 2026 ; NVIDIA, 2026 ) . However, these broad capabilities do not necessarily provide the precise, task-conditioned perception required for physical interaction, leaving a capability mismatch between pretraining and action learning. Together, this capability mismatch motivates closer study of how precise perception can support action learning.
blocks.zh: 物理智能模型越来越多地继承大规模预训的补充前科. VLA模型以VLMs为基础,传输广义的视觉语义知识和语言定位(Kim等人,2024年;Black等人,2024年),而WAMs则对视频和世界模型进行改造,以利用时空和视觉动力学前传(Kim等人,2026年;Ye等人,2026年;Wang等人,2026年b). 健全的基础模型进一步将语义、动态和内含的经验结合起来,实现更普遍的物理智能(Intelligence等人,2025年;NVIDIA等人,2025年;Dang等人,2026年;NVIDIA,2026年)。 然而,这些广泛的能力不一定能提供身体互动所需的精确的、有任务条件的感知,从而在培训前和行动学习之间留下能力不匹配。 这种能力不匹配共同促使人们更密切地研究精确感知如何支持行动学习.

blocks.en: 2.3 Perceptual Learning for Action Transfer
blocks.zh: 2.3 认知学习促进行动转移

blocks.en: Recent policy recipes strengthen perception through bounding-box prediction, task-relevant region reconstruction, affordance representations, and spatial auxiliary supervision ( Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Song et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2026 ; Tu et al., 2026 ; You et al., 2026 ; Shen et al., 2026 ) . These approaches demonstrate the value of perception, but usually introduce it as a task-specific proxy, auxiliary objective, or intermediate representation within action learning. Such mechanisms cover selected perceptual signals, often depend on additional annotations or policy-specific components, and are difficult to scale across the diverse scenes and perceptual demands of physical intelligence. Together, these limitations motivate a perception-native foundation model: one that learns broad and precise perception before action adaptation, so downstream policies can build on perception rather than recover it from task-specific proxies.
blocks.zh: 近期的政策配方通过边框预测、与任务相关的区域重建、负担率表示和空间辅助监督加强认知(Intelligence等人,2025年;Song等人,2026年;Yu等人,2026年;Tu等人,2026年;You等人,2026年;Shen等人,2026年). 这些方法显示了感知的价值,但通常将其引入作为特定任务代用,辅助目标,或动作学习中的中间代表. 这类机制涵盖某些感知信号,往往取决于附加说明或政策特定组成部分,而且难以在各种场景和对物理智能的感知要求中加以扩展。 这些局限性共同激发了一种认知-内在基础模型:一种在行动适应前学习广泛和准确认知的模式,因此下游政策可以建立在认知之上,而不是从特定任务代词中恢复.

blocks.en: 3 GroundingPI: A Grounding Foundation Model
blocks.zh: 3 铺设地基 PI:一个打地基模型

blocks.en: 3.1 Model Architecture and Grounding Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 示范建筑和地基设计

blocks.en: GroundingPI is an autoregressive grounding foundation model for language-conditioned perception. As shown in Figure 1 , it couples a MoonViT-V2 (Kimi K3) visual encoder ( Team et al., 2026 ) with a Qwen3-4B language decoder ( Yang et al., 2025a ) . A learnable projector aggregates adjacent 2 × 2 2\times 2 visual features and maps them to the language embedding space through a two-layer MLP with GELU and output normalization.
blocks.zh: 设地 PI是语言条件感知的自递式地基模型. 如图1所示,它将一个月球ViT-V2(Kimi K3)视觉编码器(Team等人,2026年)与一个Quen3-4B语言解码器(Yang等人,2025a年)相配. 一个可学习的投影仪聚合了相邻的2×2 2\times 2视觉特性,并通过带有GELU和输出正常化的两层MLP将其映射到语言嵌入空间.

blocks.en: Base training first aligns the projector using image-caption supervision while freezing both backbones. blocks.en: 4 GroundingPI Model towards Physical Intelligence
blocks.zh: 4 物理情报模型

blocks.en: GroundingPI provides a strong perceptual interface for action learning. We study whether its precise, language-conditioned grounding representations translate into stronger action-learning capabilities in two downstream physical-intelligence paradigms: trajectory prediction for autonomous driving and continuous control for robot manipulation. Each domain retains its native action learner, while GroundingPI serves as the shared perceptual foundation.
blocks.zh: 设地 PI为动作学习提供了强大的感知界面. 我们研究其精确的、基于语言条件的地面表述是否转化为两个下游物理情报范式中更强的行动学习能力:自主驾驶的轨迹预测和机器人操纵的持续控制。 每个域都保留其本土动作学习者,而GroundingPI则作为共同的认知基础.

blocks.en: 4.1 Autonomous Driving
blocks.zh: 4.1 自动驾驶

blocks.en: We formulate autonomous driving on nuScenes ( Caesar et al., 2020 ) as language-conditioned trajectory prediction ( ). Given the current front-camera image and historical ego states, the token-based interface represents the future trajectory as six ordered waypoints at 0.5-second intervals over a three-second horizon. Each waypoint specifies a cumulative position in the current ego frame, with forward and left axes measured in meters. Fixed metric ranges map these coordinates to GroundingPI’s existing <0> – <999> vocabulary. The language head generates the trajectory autoregressively, and response-only cross-entropy provides the adaptation objective. Decoding recovers metric waypoints while preserving their temporal order. Coordinate conventions and the open-loop L2 metric are detailed in Section 8.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们在nuScenes(Caesar等人,2020年)上制定自主驾驶,作为语言条件的轨迹预测(......)。 鉴于目前的前摄像头图像和历史自负状态,基于符号的界面代表了未来的轨迹,在三秒钟的视野内,以0.5秒的间隔,作为六个定点的路径点. 每一个方法点都指定了在当前自我框架的累积位置,前轴和左轴用米测量. 固定的测量范围将这些坐标映射到地表平面PI现有的<0> - <999>词汇。 语言头会自动生成轨迹,而只反应的交叉交替提供适应目标. 解码在保持时间顺序的同时恢复了衡量的方法点。 第8.1节详细介绍了各项协调公约和开放式L2指标。

blocks.en: 4.2 Robot Manipulation
blocks.zh: 4.2 机器人操纵

blocks.en: For robot manipulation, we follow the π \pi -style flow-matching policy ( Black et al., 2024 ) and adopt the layer-wise connection used in StarVLA ( Community, 2026 ) ( ). The pretrained foundation encodes the visual observation and language instruction once; its intermediate features are projected and resampled, then injected into the corresponding cross-attention layers of an Action DiT. Conditioned on these features and the robot state, the action expert denoises a noisy action chunk into continuous controls.
blocks.zh: 对于机器人操作,我们遵循\\pi-风格的流量匹配政策(Black等人,2024年),并采用StarVLA(社区,2026年)中使用的分层连接( ) ( ) 。 预先训练的基础将视觉观察和语言指示编码一次; 其中间特性被预测和重印, 然后注入一个动作DiT的相应交叉注意层。 对这些特性和机器人状态, 动作专家将一个吵闹的动作隐藏在连续控制中。

blocks.en: To compare perceptual foundations under the same action-learning setup, we follow the two adaptation pathways implemented in StarVLA: Wan- π \pi for video-generation backbones and the StarVLA π \pi -style pathway for vision-language foundations. This yields four controlled model families: general-purpose vision-language models , video-generation backbones , grounding models , and embodied foundation models . Within each benchmark, we keep the Action DiT, robot data, action representation, optimization budget, and inference procedure fixed, varying only the pretrained foundation. We compare their action acquisition and generalization, with full implementation details in Section 8.2 .

blocks.en: 5.1 Grounding Benchmark Results
blocks.zh: 5.1 基准结果

blocks.en: We evaluate GroundingPI against 44 baselines on 34 benchmarks spanning 11 perceptual capabilities, covering specialized detectors, general-purpose VLMs, grounding specialists, and embodied foundations. All numerical results and conclusions involving our models are based on the mean of ten runs, using five random seeds with two runs per seed. Owing to the high computational cost, other baselines that we evaluate locally for the main leaderboard are averaged over three runs, using three random seeds with one run per seed. GPT-6 Astra is evaluated with thinking effort set to High . We use F1mIoU for box grounding and OCR, F1@Point for object pointing, and task-specific accuracy for spatial and robo and GUI grounding.
blocks.zh: 我们根据34个基准的44个基线对地面测量指数进行评价,这些基准涵盖11个认知能力,包括专门探测器、通用甚高分辨率辐射计、地面专家,并包含各种基础。 涉及我们模型的所有数字结果和结论都以10次运行的平均值为基础,使用5个随机种子,每个种子有2次运行. 由于计算成本高,我们在当地对主标盘进行评价的其他基线平均在3次运行中,使用3个随机种子,每个种子1次运行. GPT-6 Astra被评为高智商。 我们使用F1mIoU来进行箱底定位和OCR定位,F1@Point来进行对象指点定位,以及空间定位、robo定位和图形用户界面定位的特定任务精确度。

blocks.en: GroundingPI attains an average open-loop L2 error of 0.296 m, improving on Qwen3-VL-4B (0.301 m) and RynnBrain (0.308 m); the trajectory interface and metric are defined in Section 8.1 . Reading road signs also motivates accurate and timely OCR in vision-based driving, although this evaluation does not isolate sign reading or measure its latency. blocks.en: We evaluate the vision-language and video-generation foundations summarized in Figure 5 , spanning the backbone families used in VLA and WAM systems. To compare their contribution to action learning under controlled downstream conditions, we couple every backbone to the same layer-wise Action DiT. Following the conditioning design of π 0 \pi_{0} ( Black et al., 2024 ) , intermediate features from a single backbone forward pass are projected and resampled to a common interface, then injected into the corresponding cross-attention blocks of the action expert. Within each benchmark, all runs keep the Action DiT architecture, action-training data, optimization budget, action representation, and inference procedure fixed, and vary only the pretrained foundation. This controlled comparison allows us to assess how effectively each foundation supports downstream action learning and how well the resulting policies generalize out of distribution. Section 8.2 provides the implementation.
blocks.zh: 我们评价图5总结的视觉语言和视频生成基础,包括VLA和WAM系统所使用的骨干家庭。 为了比较它们在受控下游条件下对动作学习的贡献,我们把每个主干部分与同一层的动作DiT对齐. 遵循π0\pi_{0}(Black et al., 2024)的调制设计,从单一主干前传的中间特性被预测并重印到共同接口,然后注入动作专家相应的交叉注意块. 在每一个基准内,所有运行都保持Action DiT架构,动作训练数据,优化预算,动作表现和推论程序固定,并只改变预先训练的基础. 这种有控制的比较使我们能够评估每个基金会如何有效地支持下游行动学习,以及由此产生的政策如何将分布范围普遍化。 第8.2节规定了执行情况。

blocks.en: We report task success rate (SR) across two representative embodiments: fixed-base bimanual tabletop manipulation on RoboTwin2.0 and humanoid dexterous-hand manipulation on RoboCasa-GR1. In-distribution (ID) evaluation follows the full training and evaluation protocol of each benchmark. For out-of-distribution (OOD) evaluation, policies are trained on ID data and tested under held-out conditions.
blocks.zh: 我们报告任务成功率(SR)涉及两个具有代表性的化身:对RoboTwin2.0进行固定基底双人台操纵和对RoboCasa-GR1进行人造假手操纵。 分配评价遵循每个基准的全面培训和评价规程。 在分配外(OO)评价中,对政策进行ID数据培训,并在搁置条件下进行测试.

blocks.en: • Fixed-base bimanual — RoboTwin2.0. This widely adopted benchmark spans 50 tabletop manipulation tasks ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . RoboTwin2.0-Full trains and evaluates on both Clean and Randomized data, whereas RoboTwin2.0-Clean2Random trains only on Clean demonstrations and evaluates on Randomized scenes. The released Randomized setting retains the same manipulation tasks but varies scene clutter, lighting, table and background textures, tabletop height, and language instructions. It therefore primarily evaluates scene robustness under environmental variation. • Humanoid dexterous-hand — RoboCasa-GR1. This benchmark evaluates fine-grained manipulation from head-camera observations without wrist cameras ( Nasiriany et al., 2024 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) . Its full protocol measures ID performance, while OOD evaluation uses three held-out suites ( Chen et al., 2026a ) : Unseen Appearance applies novel textures to familiar object–container pairs; Unseen Combinations places seen objects in novel container pairings; and Unseen Object Types introduces novel object categories. These suites evaluate entity generalization across object appearances, object categories, and object–container combinations.
blocks.zh: • 固定基地双人型——RoboTwin2.0。 这一广泛采用的基准涉及50项桌面操纵任务(Chen等人,2025年)。 RoboTwin2.0-Full列车和对清洁和随机数据的评价,而RoboTwin2.0-Clean2Random列车则仅在清洁演示和随机场景上评价. 发行的随机化设置保留了相同的操纵任务,但有不同的场景杂乱,照明,桌子和背景纹理,桌面高度,以及语言指令. 因此,它主要评价环境变异下的场景稳健性。 · 人肉毒杆菌-机械卡萨-GR1. 这一基准评价了在没有手腕照相机的情况下从头摄像头观察中进行的精细操纵(Nasiriany等人,2024年;NVIDIA等人,2025年)。 其全程测量ID性能,而OD评价则使用三套被搁置的套房(Chen等人,2026a) : unseen Engineerance将新颖的纹理应用到熟悉的物体–容器配对中; Unseen Complies将所见物体放在新容器配对中; Unseen Object Types引入了新颖物体类别. 这些套件评价实体对对象外观、对象类别和对象-容器组合的概括。

blocks.en: Together, the two protocols evaluate scene robustness and entity generalization, two complementary requirements of an embodied foundation model. Both require stable, task-conditioned perception before action learning, making them direct tests of whether a pretrained foundation provides reusable representations for manipulation.
blocks.zh: 这两项协议共同评价场景稳健性和实体概括性,这是体现的基础模式的两个互补要求。 两者都需要在行动学习前有稳定,任务条件的感知,使其直接测试预先训练的基础是否为操纵提供了可重复使用的陈述.

blocks.en: Under the matched downstream architecture and training protocol, Figure 5 compares backbones with distinct pretraining objectives. We organize the compared backbones into four groups: general-purpose VLMs (Qwen3-VL-4B ( Bai et al., 2025a ) and PaliGemma-3B ( Beyer et al., 2024 ) ), video-generation backbones (Wan2.2-TI2V-5B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) and Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B ( Ali et al., 2025 ) ), grounding models (LocateAnything-3B ( Wang et al., 2026a ) and Rex-Omni-3B ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) ), and embodied foundation models (RynnBrain ( Dang et al., 2026 ) and RynnBrain1.1 ( Li et al., 2026 ) ). Across these heterogeneous pretraining sources, GroundingPI ranks first in five of the six evaluations, including RoboTwin2.0 Full and every OOD setting. It achieves 66.20% on RoboTwin2.0 Full and remains competitive on RoboCasa-GR1 Full at 37.75%, compared with RynnBrain’s 39.00%. These results support precise spatial perception as an effective foundation for action learning across two robot embodiments, with consistent performance under distribution shift.
blocks.zh: 根据相应的下游建筑和培训规程,图5将骨干与不同的培训前目标进行比较。 我们把比较骨干分为四组:通用VLM(Qune3-VL-4B(Bai等人,2025a)和PaliGemma-3B) (Beyer等人,2024年),视频生成骨干 (Wan2.2-TI2V-5B(Wan等人,2025年)和Cosmos-Predict2.5-2B(Ali等人,2025年)),地基模型(LocateAnything-3B(Wang等人,2026年a)和Rex-Omni-3B(Jiang等人,2026年)),并包含地基模型(RynnBrain(Dang等人,2026年)和RynnBrain1.1(Li等人,2026年)). 在这些多种多样的预培训来源中,地平线倡议在6项评价中的5项中排名第一,包括RoboTwin2.0 Full和每个OO环境。 在RoboTwin2.0 Full上取得了66.20%的成绩,在RoboCasa-GR1 Full上保持了37.75%的竞争力,而RynnBrain的39.00 %. 这些结果支持精确的空间感知,作为在两个机器人的化身中学习行动的有效基础,在分布变化中,表现一致.

blocks.en: RoboTwin2.0-Clean2Random evaluates scene robustness, while RoboCasa-GR1 evaluates entity generalization across appearances, object types, and object–container relations. GroundingPI ranks first in all four OOD settings. On RoboTwin2.0, it reaches 17.60%, with Rex-Omni second at 14.10%. On RoboCasa-GR1, RynnBrain ranks second across Type, Appearance, and Container OOD. Rex-Omni’s strength in scene robustness is consistent with its emphasis on detection, referring, and coordinate prediction ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . RynnBrain’s strength in entity generalization is consistent with its broader language-conditioned embodied and semantic understanding, including spatiotemporal localization and physically grounded reasoning ( Dang et al., 2026 ) . These observations highlight the complementary strengths of precise perceptual grounding and broader embodied semantic understanding.
blocks.zh: RoboTwin2.0-Clean2Random评价场景稳健性,而RoboCasa-GR1则评价实体在外观,对象类型,以及对象-容器关系等各方面的概括性. 设地 PI在所有四个OOD设置中排名第一. 在RoboTwin2.0上达到17.60%,Rex-Omni以14.10%的成绩位居第二. 在RoboCasa-GR1上,RynnBrain在类型、外观和集装箱OOD中排名第二。 Rex-Omni在现场稳健的实力与其对探测、参考和协调预测的重视是一致的(Jiang等人,2026年)。 RynnBrain在实体概括方面的实力与其更广泛的语言条件所体现和语义理解是一致的,包括瞬间本地化和基于物理的推理(Dang等人,2026年). 这些意见突出了精确的认知基础和更广泛的体现语义理解的互补性优势。

blocks.en: Figure 6 illustrates a conceptual progression from action-only adaptation of general VLMs, through perceptual supervision in the π \pi family, to grounding as a native foundation capability ( Black et al., 2024 ; Intelligence et al., 2025 ; Driess et al., 2025 ) . GroundingPI retains broad VQA-style, language-conditioned semantic knowledge while emphasizing precise spatial perception through grounding and pointing supervision. Visual primitives provide an interface for physical prompting, specifying targets, locations, and structures alongside language. Together with precise spatial perception, this interface supports scene robustness and entity generalization. Our transfer results evaluate the pretrained foundation for physical intelligence rather than a separate prompting intervention. The data-composition ablation in Section 5.3.2 further examines which forms of grounding supervision transfer to action.
blocks.zh: 图6显示了从只行动调整一般自愿活动指标,通过对\\pi家庭的感知监督,到作为本土基础能力的立足点的概念进展(Black等人,2024年;Intelligence等人,2025年;Driess等人,2025年)。 设地 PI保留了广义的VQA风格,语言条件的语义学知识,同时通过地面和指点监督强调精确的空间感知. 视觉原始为物理提示提供了界面,指定了目标,位置,结构与语言并列. 这种界面与精确的空间感知一起,支持场景稳健性和实体泛化. 我们的移交结果评估了身体智能的预先训练基础,而不是单独的迅速干预。 第5.3.2节的数据组合进一步审查了将监督转移至行动的依据。

We vary only the amount of action data, keeping the architecture, action-learning approach, and other training choices unchanged. GroundingPI leads all three reduced-data settings. blocks.en: These results support prioritizing precise spatial perception before action learning. The same physical-prompting interface allows scarce action demonstrations to focus on control rather than relearning basic perception. Together with the preceding results, this suggests that precise grounding supports effective and generalizable action learning as well as more data-efficient adaptation.
blocks.zh: 这些成果支持在行动学习之前优先确定准确的空间感知。 同样的物理即兴界面使得很少的动作演示能够专注于控制而不是重新学习基本感知. 与前述结果一起,这表明,精确的定位有助于有效和普遍的行动学习以及更具有数据效率的适应。

blocks.en: Figure 8 tracks the aggregate grounding score together with manipulation success on the RoboCasa-GR1 ID and OOD splits as pretraining grows from 88.4B to 221B tokens. This scaling sweep examines how perception and downstream action learning evolve together.

blocks.en: As pretraining scale increases, the grounding score rises steadily and robotic manipulation performance improves on both splits. Scaling grounding pretraining therefore strengthens precise perception and transfers to more effective and generalizable action learning.
blocks.zh: 随着预训规模的扩大,地面分数稳步上升,机器人操纵性能在两种分数上都有改善. 因此,扩大先行训练的基础,可加强准确的认识,并转而进行更有效和更普遍的行动学习。

blocks.en: The curves move together across the scaling trajectory, with generalization tracking grounding quality most closely. This correspondence links the two observations: better grounding provides a stronger perceptual foundation for downstream action learning.

blocks.en: The scaling study in Section 5.3.1 establishes that more grounding pretraining improves downstream action learning. We now ask what that data should contain. Figure 9 decomposes the training mixture into basic and dense grounding, referring, pointing, and auxiliary OCR, layout, and GUI supervision.

blocks.en: In the available leave-one-out comparisons, removing dense grounding degrades both manipulation splits and nuScenes performance more than removing referring or robo pointing. In driving and manipulation, relevant targets may be densely packed or small relative to the image, coupling dense and tiny-object perception through a shared need for fine-grained spatial discrimination. Dense multi-object supervision therefore provides the core precise spatial perception that transfers across downstream domains.
blocks.zh: 在现有的 " 一停 " 比较中,除去 " 引号 " 或 " robo " 指针外,去除密集的地面会降低操纵分裂和nuScenes性能。 在驱动和操纵时,相关目标可能与图像相对密集或小,通过共同需要精细的空间区分,将密集和微小的物体感知结合在一起。 因此,对多物体的严密监督提供了跨下游域转移的核心精确空间感知。

blocks.en: Removing the OCR-containing group causes the largest manipulation losses on both splits (5.33/3.63 pp), yet this group alone transfers poorly. We hypothesize that OCR catalyzes perceptual learning: sharp character boundaries demand local precision, while transcription binds visual regions to semantics, providing a localized captioning proxy task for vision–language alignment. Such supervision could strengthen fine-grained ViT features and amplify the benefits of dense spatial supervision for grounding and downstream action learning. Additional OCR mixing experiments favor combining cold-start and batch-level supervision for manipulation transfer; the OCR-specific mechanism remains a hypothesis ( Section 9.4 ).
blocks.zh: 消除含OCR的集团对两个拆分造成最大的操纵损失(5.33/3.63页),但仅这一集团就转移得很差。 我们假设OCR催化了知觉学习:尖锐的性格界限要求局部精度,而抄录则将视觉区域绑定在语义上,为视觉-语言对齐提供了本地化的标题代理任务. 这种监督可以加强精细的虚拟技术特征,扩大密集空间监督对地面和下游行动学习的好处。 其他OCR混合实验倾向于将冷启动和批量监管结合起来,以进行操纵转让;OCR特定机制仍然是一个假设(第9.4节)。

blocks.en: No reduced mixture matches the full mixture simultaneously across manipulation performance and nuScenes localization. Dense grounding supplies the spatial core, auxiliary perception sharpens the visual representation, and referring and pointing connect that representation to language and action-relevant targets. Together with the scaling study, these results show that scale determines how much grounding capability is learned, while composition determines whether it forms an effective and generalizable interface for action learning.
blocks.zh: 在操纵性能和nuScases本地化方面,没有减少的混合物与全部混合物同时匹配。 密集的地面提供空间核心,辅助感知使视觉表现更加清晰,并提及和指出这种表现与语言和与行动有关的目标之间的联系。 这些结果与缩放研究一起表明,缩放决定了学习多少地基能力,而组成则决定了它是否构成行动学习的有效和泛泛的界面.

blocks.en: Finding 3.2: Dense grounding provides the strongest spatial core in the available leave-one-out comparisons, while auxiliary OCR, layout, and GUI supervision is most valuable in combination; the full mixture performs best across manipulation and driving.
blocks.zh: 调查结果3.2: " 深层搁浅 " 提供了现有 " 一放一放 " 比较中最强的空间核心,而辅助性OCR、布局和GUI监督在组合方面最有价值;在操控和驾驶方面,完整的混合效果最好。

blocks.en: 5.3.3 Discussion

The backbone comparisons suggest possible sensitivities beyond supervision. RynnBrain1.1 trails RynnBrain in all six manipulation settings despite improving driving. Its Qwen3.5 base combines Gated DeltaNet with gated attention, whereas RynnBrain uses Qwen3-VL ( Li et al., 2026 ; Dang et al., 2026 ; Qwen Team, 2026a ) . Recurrent compression and output gating may affect access to spatial features under a new action objective; Section 10.2 derives conditional memory and gradient effects ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Qiu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 骨干比较表明,可能的敏感性超出了监督范围。 RynnBrain1.1尽管驾驶情况有所改善,但在所有6个操纵环境都追上了RynnBrain. 其Quen3.5基地将Gated DeltaNet与关卡关注相结合,而RynnBrain则使用Quen3-VL(Li等人,2026年;Dang等人,2026年;Quen Team,2026a年). 经常性的压缩和输出点标可能影响根据新的行动目标获取空间特征; 第10.2节产生有条件的内存和梯度效应(Yang等人,2025b;Quu等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: DeepStack enriches visual evidence through intermediate feature injection, but may also increase the demands of aligning several feature levels with an action readout ( Bai et al., 2025a ; Meng et al., 2024 ) . GroundingPI instead couples MoonViT-V2 to a full-attention Qwen3-4B decoder through a single visual interface. Since RynnBrain and Qwen3-VL both use DeepStack, their driving difference cannot isolate this mechanism ( Section 10.3 ). The older Qwen2.5-VL foundations of Rex-Omni and LocateAnything also leave base-model quality as a possible factor. These comparisons motivate controlled studies of feature accessibility and alignment; they do not establish architectural causes of the observed rankings.
blocks.zh: DeepStack通过中间特性注入来丰富视觉证据,但也可能会增加使若干特性水平与动作读取一致的要求(Bai等人,2025a); 孟等, 2024 ). 设地 PI转而通过单一的视觉界面将MoonViT-V2配为全心全意的Quen3-4B解码器. 由于RynnBrain和Qune3-VL都使用DeepStack,他们的驱动差异不能孤立这种机制(第10.3节). Rex-Omni和Locher Anything的更古老的Quen2.5-VL基础也留下了基模质量作为可能的因素. 这些比较促使对特征的可获取性和一致性进行有控制的研究;它们没有确定所观察到的排名的建筑原因。

blocks.en: Takeaway 3: Base-model selection should consider architectural effects on training dynamics and the transfer of perceptual capabilities to action.
blocks.zh: 外卖 3: 基地模型的选择应考虑建筑对培训动态的影响,以及将认知能力转移到行动。

blocks.en: From first principles, a useful starting point is what spatial information the visual input can actually determine. An image records projected structure, while its absolute metric scale may remain ambiguous. Human perception illustrates this limitation: we may readily identify and localize a distant object yet struggle to judge whether it is 25 m or 30 m away. A raw L 1 L_{1} depth loss nevertheless assigns a 5 m error, which need not reflect the perceptual difficulty; a fixed metric tolerance also has different implications for close-range manipulation and distant scenes. Under perspective projection, small image-space errors can further translate into larger metric depth and 3D localization errors at longer ranges. These considerations motivate a hypothesis: grounding may help elicit and develop spatial intelligence in VLMs by forcing spatial understanding to become explicit through precise localization . Predicting boxes and points ties language to specific visual regions, providing low-level supervision that may compel the model to preserve and use fine-grained spatial evidence. Relative depth, such as scene-normalized values in [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] , could offer complementary supervision of depth ordering and scene structure without requiring absolute scale. We therefore conjecture that prioritizing these visually grounded targets may better cultivate transferable perception, with metric calibration learned for downstream action. This is a hypothesis about perceptual pretraining, and the proposed advantage over absolute metric supervision remains untested in our study.
blocks.zh: 从第一原理出发,一个有用的起点是视觉输入可以实际确定的空间信息. 图像记录预测结构,而其绝对尺度可能仍然模糊不清。 人类的认知说明了这种局限性:我们可能很容易发现一个遥远的物体并将其定位,但却难以判断它是25米还是30米。 原始L 1 LQQQ1} 深度损失仍分配出5米误差, 这不需要反映知觉难度; 固定的度量耐性对近距离操纵和遥远的场景也有不同的影响. 在视角投影下,小的图像空间误差可以进一步转化为更大的度量深度和更长范围内的3D本地化误差. 这些考虑激发了一种假设:地面定位可能通过精确的本地化迫使空间理解变得明确,从而帮助在VLM中获取和发展空间智能。 预测框和指点将语言与特定的视觉区域联系起来,提供低水平的监督,可能迫使模型保存和使用精细的空间证据。 相对深度,如[0,1] [0,1]中的场景常态值,可以在不需要绝对尺度的情况下对深度顺序和场景结构提供互补监督. 因此,我们猜想,将这些有目共睹的目标列为优先事项,可以更好地培养可转移的认知,为下游行动学习到衡量标准。 这是一个关于概念性先行训练的假设,而我们的研究中仍然没有测试提议的相对于绝对度量监督的优势.

blocks.en: A useful distinction may be between deliberative planning (System 2) and fast perception–action execution (System 1), as explored in dual-system robotics ( NVIDIA et al., 2025 ; Bu et al., 2025 ) . Planning can benefit from extensive knowledge, coding, and long-horizon reasoning; execution requires timely feedback, precise interaction perception, and reliable control. The analogy to coding agents is functional: sophisticated reasoning has limited practical value when generated programs repeatedly fail to run, just as strong planning can be constrained by unreliable physical execution.
blocks.zh: 如双系统机器人学(NVIDIA等人,2025年;Bu等人,2025年)所探讨的,审议规划(第2阶段)和快速感知-行动执行(第1阶段)之间可作有益的区分。 规划可以得益于广泛的知识,编码和长视野推理;执行需要及时的反馈,精确的互动感知,以及可靠的控制. 对编码代理的类比是功能性的:复杂的推理在生成的程序屡次无法运行时,实用价值有限,同样强力的规划也可能受到不可靠的物理执行的限制.

blocks.en: General VLMs, including Qwen and the PaliGemma base of π 0 \pi_{0} ( Bai et al., 2025a ; Black et al., 2024 ) , offer valuable starting points, but may not best serve every execution role. GroundingPI explores a perception-native alternative: learning where to interact before limited action data teach how to act . Astra provides a frontier reference for grounding quality; comparison with it probes the perceptual frontier rather than its suitability for direct VLA adaptation. Such frontier models may instead serve higher-level planning roles. Our results motivate stronger perceptual foundations for System 1; a deployed dual-system controller and its latency remain to be evaluated ( Section 10.4 ).
blocks.zh: 普通VLMs,包括Qwen和PaliGemma基数0\pi\0}(Bai等人,2025a); Black et al., 2024 ),提供了宝贵的起点,但可能不是每个执行角色的最佳服务. 设地 PI探索一种感知-内在的替代:在有限的动作数据教导如何行动之前,先学习在哪里互动. Astra为地面质量提供了前沿参考;与其比较,可以探究知觉前沿,而不是它是否适合直接适用VLA。 这种前沿模式可发挥更高级别的规划作用。 我们的成果激发了对系统1的更强有力的认识基础;部署的双系统控制器及其延迟性仍有待评估(第10.4节)。

blocks.en: Takeaway 4: Planning and execution may benefit from different foundations: broad reasoning models for System 2, and perception-native foundations for reliable System 1 execution, as explored by GroundingPI.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We introduced GroundingPI, a 4B-parameter grounding foundation model for broad and precise perception. Across 34 grounding benchmarks, it outperforms similarly sized models and remains competitive with GPT-6 Astra, while transferring effectively to driving and manipulation.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了地面测量仪,一种4B参数的地面测量基础模型,用于广泛和精确的认知。 在34个基准基础上,它的业绩超过了类似大小的模型,并且仍然与GPT-6 Astra具有竞争力,同时有效地转向驱动和操纵。

blocks.en: Reliable physical interaction requires connecting instructions to precise spatial targets, a capability that general semantic understanding alone does not guarantee and scarce action supervision may not adequately develop. Dedicated grounding pretraining directly addresses this perceptual gap, supporting better manipulation generalization and action-data efficiency. Our analyses highlight basic grounding as an important foundation, dense grounding as valuable for physical interaction, and OCR as a potential catalyst for perceptual learning. These findings motivate distinct embodied foundations: broad reasoning for System 2 planning, and precise perception for reliable System 1 execution, the direction explored by GroundingPI.
blocks.zh: 可靠的物理相互作用要求将指示与精确的空间目标联系起来,这种能力一般语义理解本身并不能保证,而且稀少的行动监督可能无法得到充分发展。 专门基础的预训直接解决了这一认知差距,支持更好的操纵一般化和行动数据效率。 我们的分析强调,基本地基是一个重要的基础,密集地地地基是物理互动的宝贵基础,而OCR是认知学习的潜在催化剂。 这些结论激发了不同的体现基础:对系统2规划的广义推理,对可靠系统1执行的准确认识,即GroundingPI探索的方向.

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: This work does not involve human-subject studies. All grounding datasets and evaluation benchmarks used in this work were obtained from publicly available or appropriately licensed sources in accordance with their respective terms and licenses. Driving was evaluated offline on nuScenes, and robot manipulation in simulation; no real-world vehicles or robots were deployed in these experiments. GroundingPI is developed as a general-purpose visual grounding foundation model for research, with downstream experiments intended to study how precise spatial perception transfers to physical-intelligence tasks rather than to demonstrate real-world autonomous deployment. We encourage appropriate safety evaluation and human oversight before applying such models to real-world embodied systems. The authors declare no conflicts of interest.
blocks.zh: 这项工作不涉及人的学科研究。 这项工作使用的所有基础数据集和评价基准都是根据各自条款和许可证从公开或适当许可的来源获得的。 在nuScenes上对驾驶进行了离线评估,并在模拟中进行了机器人操纵;在这些实验中没有部署现实世界的车辆或机器人. 设地 PI是作为研究的通用视觉地基模型开发的,下游实验旨在研究空间感知如何精确地转移到物理智能任务上,而不是展示现实世界的自主部署. 我们鼓励在将这种模式应用于现实世界所体现的系统之前,进行适当的安全评价和人的监督。 提交人宣布没有利益冲突。

blocks.en: Reproducibility Statement
blocks.zh: 可复制声明

blocks.en: We will publicly release the code, model weights, and evaluation data for GroundingPI to support systematic and reproducible evaluation. The release will include training configurations and evaluation scripts with standardized task prompts, output parsers, and metric implementations. The input/output protocol, coordinate conventions, architecture, tokenizer, and visual processing are detailed in Sections 7.1 and 7.2 ; data construction and validation in Section 7.3 ; and base-model training, spatial supervised fine-tuning, and optimization hyperparameters in Section 7.4 . Downstream interfaces, the shared action architecture, matched training budgets, and driving and manipulation evaluation protocols are specified in Sections 8.1 and 8.2 . Data-efficiency, scaling, training-mixture, and OCR-mixing studies are documented in Sections 9.1 , 9.2 , 9.3 and 9.4 . The benchmark suite, evaluation metrics, reporting conventions, and complete grounding results are provided in Section 12 , including the visual-prompting evaluations in Section 12.9 .

blocks.en: 7.3 Data Engine
blocks.zh: 第7.3条 数据引擎

blocks.en: The engine combines complementary predictions for object localization, segmentation, text recognition, GUI elements, and document regions. For category-level grounding, category discovery precedes category-conditioned localization. Candidate instances are mapped to the original image and aligned within a common query scope and annotation granularity. Fusion operates separately on semantic and geometric fields: verified information is retained, while disagreements trigger additional evidence for the affected fields. Object–part containment and word–line relations are preserved rather than merged as duplicates.
blocks.zh: 该引擎结合了对象本地化,分区化,文本识别,GUI元素以及文档区域的互补预测. 对于类别一级地面,类别发现先于类别有条件的地方化. 候选实例被映射到原始图像中,并在共同查询范围和注释颗粒度范围内对齐。 组合在语义字和几何字段上分别运作:保留已核实的信息,而分歧则触发对受影响字段的额外证据. 对象 - 部分封装和单词 - 线关系被保留,而不是作为重复合并.

blocks.en: Each field is marked as accepted, rejected, or unresolved. Validation checks geometry, syntax, semantic correspondence, and consistency with available evidence. Required fields are determined by the query, independently of which fields a teacher produces; missing required fields remain unresolved. A supervision item is accepted only when all required fields are accepted. Queries requiring all instances additionally require a coverage check over the relevant region. For an absent-target answer, absence is itself a required fact to verify; an empty prediction does not establish it. Consequently, an unresolved instance can block an all-target or counting query while leaving independently verified local supervision usable. Multi-teacher agreement supports validation but does not guarantee annotation correctness.
blocks.zh: 每个字段标为接受、拒绝或未解决。 验证检查几何,语法,语义通信,并与现有证据保持一致. 所需字段由查询决定,独立于教师制作的字段;所需缺失字段仍未解决。 只有在所有必要的领域都得到接受时,才接受监督项目。 要求所有实例的查询还需要对有关区域进行覆盖检查。 对于一个缺席-目标答案,缺席本身就是一个必须核实的事实;空洞的预测并不能证实. 因此,一个未解决的案例可以阻挡一个全目标查询或计数查询,同时留下独立核实的本地监督可用。 多教师协议支持验证,但不保证注释正确.

blocks.en: Accepted annotations train a unified grounding expert, whose subsequent predictions pass through the same fusion and validation procedure. Complementary teachers and local observations are invoked when semantic identity, geometry, or coverage remains unresolved. Crop predictions are mapped back to the original coordinates; supervision requiring detail unavailable in the original training input retains the necessary local view. Additional evidence can both add annotations and revise existing labels. Revisions propagate to dependent tasks, and invalidated labels are withdrawn until their dependencies are resolved.
blocks.zh: 接受说明 训练一名统一的地面专家,其随后的预测通过同样的聚变和验证程序. 在语义特征、几何或覆盖范围尚未解决时,会援引补充教师和地方观察。 作物预测被映射回原始坐标;在原始培训投入中需要详细内容的监督保留必要的局部视图。 补充证据既可以添加说明,也可以修改现有的标签. 修改推广到依赖性任务,无效的标签被撤销,直到其依赖性得到解决.

blocks.en: A verified instance record can support several tasks: category–box pairs provide grounding, attributes and relations support referring, valid instance regions support pointing, exemplar correspondence supports visual prompting, and text regions paired with transcriptions support OCR. Each derived query retains its own required fields and coverage conditions. This reuse preserves task-specific semantics while sharing the underlying visual evidence.
blocks.zh: 经核实的实例记录可以支持几个任务: 类别 - box 配对 提供定位,属性和关系支持 引用, 有效实例区域支持指针, 实例函证支持视觉提示, 文本区域与文本支持 OCR 对齐 。 每个衍生的查询都保留了自己的所需字段和覆盖条件. 这种再利用保留了特定任务语义,同时分享了基本的视觉证据.

blocks.en: 7.4 Base VLM Training (Pretrain 1)
blocks.zh: 7.4 基本VLM培训(Pretrain 1)

blocks.en: GroundingPI training comprises three successive phases: (i) Base VLM training (Pretrain 1), (ii) coordinate alignment (Pretrain 2), also termed supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and (iii) reinforcement learning (RL) with GRPO. Pretrain 1 contains Stages 1–3 below, while Pretrain 2 corresponds to Stage 4. Thus, Stage 1–4 numbering describes the supervised training recipe within the first two phases. Each stage starts from the preceding checkpoint, and RL follows the Stage 4 SFT checkpoint. The aggregate training exposure is 500.41 ​ B + 221.17 ​ B 500.41\mathrm{B}+221.17\mathrm{B} tokens.

blocks.en: We freeze the visual encoder and language model and update only the projector using image-caption supervision. Causal cross-entropy on the assistant response aligns visual features with the language input space, without an additional feature-distance or contrastive objective. The context and packing lengths are both 8192 tokens.

blocks.en: We unfreeze the visual encoder, projector, and language model and jointly train on text-only and general image–text data. Text examples provide full-token causal supervision, while multimodal examples supervise assistant responses. The language model uses a peak learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and the visual encoder and projector each use 10 − 6 10^{-6} . The context and packing lengths remain 8192 tokens.
blocks.zh: 我们解冻视觉编码器、投影仪和语言模型,并联合培训文本和一般图像文本数据。 文本示例提供了完整的因果监督,而多式联运示例则监督助理的反应。 语言模型使用10−5 10−5}的峰值学习率,视觉编码器和投影器各使用10−6 10−6}. 上下文和包装长度仍为8192令牌.

blocks.en: We continue updating all modules on general visual question answering and instruction-following data, image captions, and videos. The context and packing lengths increase to 32768 tokens to accommodate longer multimodal sequences. This stage does not separately mix in the spatial-specialization data or an independent text-only quota; image-caption supervision remains part of the general visual training mixture.

blocks.en: 7.5 Coordinate Alignment (Pretrain 2 / SFT)
blocks.zh: 7.5 坐标对齐(Pretrain 2/SFT)

blocks.en: Starting from the Stage 3 checkpoint, coordinate alignment updates all modules using eight spatial task groups: detection, GUI grounding, referring-expression grounding, referring-expression pointing, OCR, document layout, dense pointing and counting, and visual prompting. This phase is the SFT phase described in the main text. It uses an 8192-token context and packing length and applies autoregressive supervision to semantic labels, box and point coordinates, and protocol markers. Quantized coordinate tokens share the same cross-entropy objective as other valid response tokens; no additional IoU regression loss is introduced.

blocks.en: 8.2 Robot Manipulation

blocks.en: The manipulation study compares the foundations used by vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action model (WAM) systems without allowing their native action heads, conditioning paths, or optimization budgets to become additional variables. We replace the model-specific control modules with the same backbone-to-action interface and the same fixed-capacity action expert. The evaluated variable is therefore the pretrained foundation that supplies the representation for action learning.
blocks.zh: 操纵研究比较了视觉语言行动(VLA)和世界行动模型(WAM)系统所使用的基础,而不允许其本土行动头目,调节路径,或优化预算成为额外的变量. 我们用相同的主干对操作接口和相同的固定能力动作专家来取代模型特定控制模块. 因此,被评价的变量是提供行动学习代表性的预先训练的基础。

blocks.en:
For each observation and language instruction, the foundation backbone is executed once. Given a backbone with N B N_{B} transformer blocks, we sample eight hidden states at normalized depths ℓ j = round ⁡ ( j ⁡ ( N B − 1 ) / 7 ) \ell_{j}=\operatorname{round}(j(N_{B}-1)/7) for j ∈ { 0 , … , 7 } j\in\{0,\ldots,7\} .
This rule preserves comparable relative depths across foundations with different numbers of layers and avoids selecting backbone-specific layers. Each sampled state H ℓ j H_{\ell_{j}} is normalized, mapped from the backbone width D B D_{B} to the common action width by a backbone-specific linear projector, augmented with a learned depth embedding, and compressed by a shared learned-query resampler: Z j = LN ⁡ ( H ℓ j ) ​ W B + e j Z_{j}=\operatorname{LN}(H_{\ell_{j}})W_{B}+e_{j} and C j = Resampler 64 ⁡ ( Z j ) C_{j}=\operatorname{Resampler}_{64}(Z_{j}) .
The projector W B W_{B} is shared across the eight depths of a backbone, and the same resampler is shared across both depths and models. Every cross-attention block consequently receives the same number and width of condition tokens, independent of the backbone’s native width or token count.

For VLA foundations, the eight states are taken from the language-conditioned vision–language stack. For WAM foundations, they are taken from the video-generation backbone under a fixed feature-extraction state, including the observed-frame construction, diffusion timestep, condition mask, noise realization, input resolution, and number of frames. In both cases, a single backbone forward pass produces all eight conditions, which are cached and reused throughout action denoising. We remove any model-specific raw-text or proprioceptive cross-attention bypass: language, perception, and dynamics information can reach the action expert only through the evaluated foundation representations. Thus, the two paradigms differ in the pretrained foundation that constructs the physical representation, while sharing the same downstream control architecture and compute schedule.

blocks.en: In Table 5 , SEED1.5-VL statistics are external values from ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , rather than a new reproduction. Dividing the reported tokens per box gives approximately 19.6 × \times and 14.6 × \times fewer tokens for GroundingPI on COCO and Dense200. These ratios quantify serialization, not measured speedups: model computation, sampling, and the distribution of predictions also matter. blocks.en: 10.4 Designing Perceptual Foundations for System 1
blocks.zh: 10.4 为系统1设计概念基础

blocks.en: A useful design hypothesis separates knowledge-intensive deliberation from rapid perception–action execution. A planning system may benefit from extensive world knowledge, coding, and long-horizon reasoning. An execution system must translate the current goal and observations into reliable interaction while incorporating timely feedback. Existing dual-system architectures provide concrete precedents: RoboDual couples a generalist with a specialist policy, and GR00T N1 couples vision–language interpretation with a diffusion action module ( Bu et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA et al., 2025 ) . These systems motivate the distinction; they do not establish that one universal division of modules is optimal.
blocks.zh: 一个有用的设计假设将知识密集型的考虑与快速感知-行动执行区分开来. 一个规划系统可能受益于广泛的世界知识、编码和长期推理。 执行系统必须将目前的目标和观察转化为可靠的互动,同时纳入及时的反馈。 现有的双系统结构提供了具体的先例: 机器人配对是具有专门政策的通才,GR00T N1配对是配有传播行动单元的配对语言解释(Bu等人,2025年;NVIDIA等人,2025年)。 这些系统激发了这种区分;它们没有确定模块的通用划分是最佳的。

blocks.en: Here, System 1 denotes the functional perception–action execution loop. Its module boundaries need not match the naming in another architecture: GR00T N1 calls its VLM System 2 and its diffusion action module System 1. Our proposal concerns the perceptual foundation supplying an action learner, rather than identifying an unadapted grounding VLM with a complete controller. The benefit sought is precise, task-conditioned information available when an action must be selected or corrected.
blocks.zh: 在此, System 1 表示功能感知 - 动作执行循环 。 它的模块边界不需要与另一个架构中的命名匹配:GR00T N1称其VLM系统2及其扩散动作模块系统1. 我们的建议涉及提供行动学习者的认知基础,而不是用完整的控制器确定未经调整的VLM。 所寻求的好处是,在必须选择或纠正某项行动时,可获得符合任务要求的准确信息。

blocks.en: The coding-agent analogy highlights the need for a dependable execution layer: increasingly sophisticated generated programs have limited practical value if they repeatedly fail to run or if their feedback cannot guide correction. In robotics, stronger plans similarly depend on correctly identifying interaction targets and executing feasible actions. Code as Policies offers a concrete connection between these roles by generating programs that combine perception outputs with control APIs ( Liang et al., 2023 ) . Our analogy motivates evaluating the complete feedback loop; it is not an empirical comparison between coding and robot-learning systems.
blocks.zh: 编码代理类比突出了一个可靠的执行层的必要性:日益复杂的生成程序如果反复无法运行或者其反馈不能指导校正,其实用价值就有限. 在机器人方面,更强有力的计划同样取决于正确确定互动目标和执行可行的行动。 作为政策的准则,通过生成将感知产出与控制性API相结合的程序,提供了这些作用之间的具体联系(Liang等人,2023年)。 我们的类比激发了对完整反馈循环的评价;这不是在编码和机器人学习系统之间的实证比较。

blocks.en: Dense and tiny-object grounding requires distinctions that can matter directly for interaction: which instance is intended, where it is, and which local region is relevant. Basic grounding supplies reusable localization, while OCR may complement it through local visual precision and semantic alignment. These observations suggest pretraining priorities for a foundation supporting execution. Broad semantic knowledge remains useful, but may be insufficient when the limiting factor is spatial discrimination. The controlled backbone comparison supports this concern for the evaluated Qwen- and PaliGemma-based foundations; it does not establish inferiority of every adaptation recipe or every member of the π \pi family. Grounding also leaves dynamics, contact, and feedback control to the downstream policy.
blocks.zh: 理智和微小物体的打地需要区别,这种区别可以直接影响相互作用:哪种情况是打算的,在哪里发生,以及哪些地方是相关的。 基本的地基供给可重新使用本地化,而OCR则可以通过局部视觉精度和语义对齐来补充. 这些意见为支助执行的基金会提出了预先培训的优先事项。 广义的语义知识仍然有用,但在限制因素是空间歧视时可能不够。 受控骨干比较为受评价的基于Quen和PaliGemma的基金会的这种关切提供了支持;它并不确定每个适应食谱或\\pi家族的每个成员都低等。 铺设地基也将动态、接触和反馈控制留给下游政策。

blocks.en: Astra is a frontier reference for grounding quality in this study. Comparing a compact grounding model with it assesses how closely specialized perception can approach a strong general-purpose reference across the evaluated capabilities. It does not define a theoretical performance ceiling or evaluate Astra as a VLA backbone. Assigning a frontier model to higher-level planning and a perception-native foundation to execution is a prospective design, compatible with the observed capability differences but not tested as an integrated system here.
blocks.zh: Astra是本研究中基础质量的前沿参考。 将紧凑的基础模型与模型相比较,可以评估专业认知如何在评价能力范围内接近于有力的通用参考。 它没有界定理论性能上限,也没有评价Astra是VLA的主干线. 将前沿模型指定为更高层次的规划,将感知-内在基础指定为执行,是一种与观察到的能力差异相兼容的远景设计,但没有作为综合系统在这里进行测试.

blocks.en: A direct evaluation would hold the planner and action expert fixed while changing the perceptual foundation, then measure task success, robustness under distribution shift, and observation-to-action latency. Perception failures should be distinguished from planning and control failures, especially for small, crowded, or ambiguous targets. Conversely, varying planner capability under a fixed execution layer would test when better reasoning helps and when interaction remains the limiting factor. The present results motivate these experiments through grounding quality, controlled action transfer, and manipulation-data efficiency; they do not yet demonstrate a real-time dual-system controller.
blocks.zh: 直接评价将固定规划人员和行动专家,同时改变观念基础,然后衡量任务的成功程度、分配转变期间的稳健性以及观察与行动间歇性。 应当将设想失败与规划和控制失败区分开来,特别是对小、拥挤或模棱两可的目标而言。 反之,固定执行层下不同的规划人员能力将在更好的推理帮助和互动仍然是限制因素时检验。 目前的结果通过地面质量、控制动作转移和操纵数据效率来激励这些实验;这些结果尚未显示实时双系统控制器。

blocks.en: 11 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 11 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: GroundingPI’s aggregate strength is not uniform dominance: tiny-box localization, high-IoU boundaries, TotalText OCR, FSC147 visual prompting, and frontier-level GUI grounding retain clear gaps. Prompt and parser compatibility also constrain several baseline measurements; unsupported evaluations are not evidence of absent intrinsic capability. The manipulation comparison controls the downstream recipe, but pretrained foundations differ in scale, architecture, and supervision. Driving is evaluated open loop, and action-data efficiency is tested only in manipulation. OCR-specific causality and the proposed architectural mechanisms remain hypotheses requiring matched interventions. Finally, physical prompting and complementary System-1 execution alongside frontier reasoning are directions suggested by the interface, rather than capabilities independently established by the current experiments.
blocks.zh: 设地 PI的聚合实力并不统一:小盒本地化、高IoU边界、TotalText OCR、FSC147视觉提示和前沿图形界面定位都保留着明显的缺口。 迅速和解析的兼容性也制约了若干基线测量;不支持的评价并不是缺乏内在能力的证据。 操纵比较控制了下游的食谱,但预先训练的地基在规模,建筑,监督上却有所不同. 驾驶经过评价为开放循环,行动数据效率只在操纵中测试. OCR特有的因果关系和拟议的建筑机制仍然是需要相应干预的假设。 最后,与前沿推理并列的物理促进和互补的System-1执行是接口所建议的方向,而不是当前实验独立建立的能力.

blocks.en: The notation defined in Section 5.1 applies throughout. R and P denote recall and precision. For box grounding, the nine columns report R/P/F1 at IoU 0.50 and 0.95, followed by their mIoU aggregates. Object pointing uses point-in-mask R/P/F1. OCR uses the recorded loose-match F1 metrics; parse error is the percentage of outputs that cannot be parsed. Named dataset-family averages are unweighted arithmetic means and are reported only when every component is available. Threshold-specific and mean-overlap metrics are retained as recorded; missing recall or precision is not inferred from F1. The headline Avg is the mean of 11 independently computed capability scores. Benchmark-level results below are reported separately and do not define this average through a direct mean of their table entries. Size groups use the language backbone configuration (the 7B understanding branch for MoT models and total language-model parameters for MoE models). Qwen3.7-Max, Kimi-K2.6, Kimi-K3, and GPT-6 Astra are grouped separately in the >1T category.

Qwen3.7-Max,Kimi-K2.6,Kimi-K3,GPT-6 Astra分别归为>1T类.

blocks.en: 13 Potential Applications
blocks.zh: 13 潜在应用

blocks.en: Language descriptions or visual exemplars could specify defects and component variants for localization, while OCR associates part markings and packaging text with their image regions. Queries can be revised as products change, and localized parts and markings provide inputs for downstream assembly checks.
blocks.zh: 语言描述或视觉实例可以指定局部化的缺陷和组件变体,而OCR则将部分标记和包装文本与其图像区域联系起来. 查询可随着产品的变化而修订,本地化的部件和标识为下游组装检查提供了投入.

blocks.en: On egocentric images and video keyframes, boxes and points can link descriptions such as “the cup beside the plate” or “the drawer handle” to objects, parts, and candidate interaction sites. The same query interface could support road-scene pre-annotation and retrieval of unusual obstacles, temporary signs, or construction equipment.
blocks.zh: 在以自我为中心的图像和视频键框上,盒和点可以将“盘子旁的杯子”或“抽屉把手”等描述与物体、部件和候选互动站点联系起来。 同样的查询界面可以支持道路风景预告和检索异常障碍、临时标志或建筑设备。

blocks.en: In aerial, retail, and agricultural imagery, instance localization could support ship, vehicle, product, or fruit counting. Referring expressions distinguish crowded targets by appearance or relative position, while visual examples specify unfamiliar objects that are difficult to name consistently.
blocks.zh: 在航空、零售和农业图像方面,地方化的例子可以支持船舶、车辆、产品或水果计数。 引用表达式通过外观或相对位置区分拥挤的目标,而视觉实例则指定了难以一致命名的陌生对象.

blocks.en: Joint text recognition and region localization can retain the positions of receipt fields, package labels, and equipment markings; layout predictions additionally identify titles, tables, and figures. These spatial associations support field verification, document retrieval, and matching text to the corresponding objects or document regions.
blocks.zh: 联合文本识别和区域本地化可以保留接收字段,包装标签,设备标识的位置;布局预测可以额外识别标题,表格和数字. 这些空间协会支持实地核查、文档检索和文本与相应的对象或文档区域匹配。

blocks.en: Requests such as “open the settings for this project” can be mapped to candidate click locations in screenshots. Combining control text, icons, and spatial context helps specify which repeated button or menu entry an interface agent should act on.
blocks.zh: 诸如“打开本项目的设置”之类的请求可映射到截图中选择的点击位置。 将控制文本、图标和空间上下文结合起来,有助于指定一个接口代理商应执行的重复按钮或菜单条目。

blocks.en: 14.1 General Object Grounding

blocks.en: Figure 12 : Multi-scale grounding in a crowded classroom scene.
blocks.zh: 图12:在拥挤的课堂场景中进行多尺度搁浅.

blocks.en: Figure 12 spans children around a table, food and plates in the foreground, chairs, and densely arranged background objects. A useful structured description must separate overlapping people and furniture while retaining smaller items on the table and shelves. This scene illustrates why broad category recognition and precise instance localization must work together: recognizing the room does not determine the boundaries of each object. The supplied Ours panel is marked as a GT-completed display, so its coverage is not used to infer unedited model recall.
blocks.zh: 图12显示儿童在桌旁、前台的食物和盘子、椅子和密集排列的背景物品。 有用的结构描述必须把重叠的人和家具分开,同时在桌子和书架上保留较小的物品。 这个场景说明了为什么广义的类别识别和精确的实例本地化必须一起工作:承认房间并不决定每个物体的界限. 提供的Ours面板被标记为GT完成的显示,因此其覆盖并不用来推断未经编辑的模型召回.

blocks.en: 14.2 Dense Object Grounding
blocks.zh: 14.2 国家 强烈对象定位

blocks.en: Figure 13 : Dense fruit grounding under partial occlusion.
blocks.zh: 图13:在部分封存下露出深色果实。

blocks.en: In Figure 13 , a top-down view places many small fruits inside a basket below a cyclist. The basket is a salient enclosing region, but the desired instance granularity concerns its contents. The comparison contrasts individual fruit boxes, overlapping proposals, and a broad container-level region. Separating partially hidden fruits requires local appearance cues and an understanding of which object level the query requests. This selected display illustrates the distinction between container recognition and instance-complete grounding.
blocks.zh: 在图13中,一个自上而下的视图将许多小水果放在自行车手下面的篮子内. 篮子是一个突出的区域,但理想的例子涉及其内容。 这种比较比较比较了单个水果箱、重叠提案和广泛的集装箱级区域。 分离部分隐藏的孳息需要局部的外观提示,并了解查询请求的对象级别。 所选的这一显示表明集装箱识别与完全停放之间的区别。

blocks.en: 14.3 Referring Grounding and Complex Visual Configurations
blocks.zh: 14.3 参照地面和复杂视觉配置

blocks.en: Figure 14 : Grounding a person through an occluded spatial relationship.
blocks.zh: 图14:通过闭塞空间关系将一个人定位.

blocks.en: Figure 14 asks for the person whose hand is behind the other two people. The displayed Ours region selects the central person, matching the illustrated reference, while the comparison panels select one of the flanking people. Resolving the expression requires connecting body parts and person-level regions despite overlapping torsos and largely hidden arms. The case illustrates compositional referring: the model must identify the entity satisfying a relationship rather than simply detect a visible hand or choose a salient face.
blocks.zh: 图14要求的是手在另外两个人后面的人。 显示的 Ours 区域会选择中心人物, 匹配显示的引用, 而比较面板会选择一个侧面人物 。 尽管躯干重叠,大部分是隐藏的臂膀,解决表达需要连接身体部位和人级区域. 案例说明了构成性参考:模型必须确定满足关系的实体,而不是简单地检测可见的手或选择突出的面孔。

blocks.en: 14.4 Referring Point-in-Mask Grounding
blocks.zh: 14.4 调试点

blocks.en: Figure 15 : Point grounding on the visible surface of a sofa.
blocks.zh: 图15:沙发可见表面的对角搁浅.

blocks.en: The two similar sofas in Figure 15 create an instance-selection challenge, while cushions and a blanket divide the visible surface of the target sofa. The reference mask highlights the right sofa’s exposed regions. The displayed points illustrate different choices of instance and local surface, with the Ours point placed on an exposed seat region. For point-in-mask evaluation, predicting a nearby cushion or the other sofa can be incorrect even when a coarse bounding box would overlap the intended object.
blocks.zh: 图15中两个相似的沙发造成了实例选择挑战,而衬垫和毯子则将目标沙发的可见表面分割开来. 参考面罩突出右侧沙发暴露区域. 显示的点说明实例和当地表面的不同选择,我们的点放在一个暴露的座位区域。 对于嵌入面罩的评价,即使粗细的边框会与预定对象重叠,预测附近的衬垫或其他沙发也可能是不正确的.

blocks.en: 14.5 Dense Point Grounding
blocks.zh: 14.5 国家 定点

blocks.en: Figure 16 : Dense point grounding in an aerial urban scene.
blocks.zh: 图16:空中城市场景中登场的地心点。

blocks.en: The aerial scene in Figure 16 contains many small targets distributed across a wide field of view, with strong perspective variation and clutter from buildings, vegetation, and roads. The panels illustrate the difference between distributed instance-level points and dense runs of nearby points that can repeatedly sample one structure. The displayed Ours pattern follows the spatial distribution of the reference more closely in this selected rendering. Because the underlying query is not printed in the figure, we restrict the analysis to point distribution and avoid inferring an unshown target category.
blocks.zh: 图16中的空中场景包含分布在广阔视野中的许多小目标,其视角变化很大,并且与建筑物、植被和道路杂乱无章。 面板说明分布的例级点和可以反复取样一种结构的近点密集运行之间的区别. 显示的 Ours 模式在此选择的渲染中更紧密地遵循引用的空间分布. 由于基础查询没有在图中打印,我们限制分析以指向分布,避免推断出一个未显示的目标类别.

blocks.en: 14.6 GUI Grounding
blocks.zh: 14.6 图形用户界面 设地

blocks.en: Figure 17 : GUI target grounding of a small side-panel control.
blocks.zh: 图17:GUI目标定位小侧板控制.

blocks.en: Figure 17 contrasts a large spreadsheet-like canvas with a small target control in the upper part of the right-side panel. The displayed Ours point aligns with the marked control, while a comparison point is drawn toward a selected central cell. The example separates semantic interface grounding from visual salience: the active cell is prominent but does not identify the requested control. Fine localization is particularly important because neighboring toolbar icons occupy only a small portion of the screenshot.
blocks.zh: 图17对比了一个类似于电子表格的大画布,右侧面板上部有一个小的目标控制. 显示的 Ours 点与标记控件一致, 而比较点则被绘制到选定的中心单元格。 例子将语义界面定位与视觉显要区分开来:活动细胞突出,但不识别请求的控制. 精细本地化特别重要,因为邻里的工具栏图标只占据了截图的一小部分.

blocks.en: 14.7 OCR and Artistic Text Understanding
blocks.zh: 14.7 OCR和艺术文本理解

blocks.en: Figure 18 : OCR of layered artistic typography and small print.
blocks.zh: 图18:分层艺术排印和小印的OCR.

blocks.en: Figure 18 mixes a large pink script word, vertical labels, small horizontal print, and a photographic background. The Ours panel identifies “Liquid” despite the enlarged, curved, and overlapping letterforms, while also localizing several smaller text regions. This combination requires separating lettering from decorative strokes and reading across markedly different spatial scales. Word-level context is helpful, but the geometry of each text region remains necessary to associate a transcription with the correct visual evidence. The display also contains imperfect small-text transcriptions, so it should not be described as error-free OCR. The case instead illustrates both the value of a strong vision–language representation for artistic lettering and the remaining difficulty of dense, layered, low-resolution print.
blocks.zh: 图18混合了一个大粉红色的脚本词,垂直的标签,小水平的打印,和一个图片背景. 我们的小组确定“Liquid”,尽管字母形式扩大、弯曲和重叠,同时也将几个较小的文本区域本地化。 这种组合需要将字母与装饰性的中风区分开来,并跨越显著不同的空间尺度阅读. 文字层次上下文很有帮助,但每个文字区域的几何学仍然有必要将一个抄录与正确的视觉证据联系起来. 显示中还包含不完美的小文本抄本,因此不应被描述为无错误的OCR. 相反,这个案例既说明了强烈的视觉-语言表现对艺术书写的价值,也说明了密集、分层、低分辨率印刷的其余困难。

blocks.en: Figure 19 : OCR of slanted display text and mixed lettering styles.
blocks.zh: 图19:斜面显示文字和混合字母样式的OCR.

blocks.en: The wall graphics in Figure 19 combine slanted display text, script, and short words distributed over illustrations. The Ours panel reads “BREAKING” and “BARRIERS” across the large diagonal composition and separates “LO” and “VE” on the foam-hand graphic. Recognizing these regions requires tolerance to irregular baselines, nonuniform glyph shapes, and competing decorative contours. The comparison also illustrates annotation granularity: “LO” and “VE” can be represented as two spatial text groups or combined as “LOVE”, depending on the protocol. Strong visual–language understanding helps connect unusual letterforms to coherent text, while localization preserves where that evidence occurs. The example supports a qualitative capability discussion rather than a claim that artistic reading is exclusive to a particular model family.
blocks.zh: 图19中的墙壁图形结合了斜面显示文字,脚本,以及分布在插图上的短词. 我们的小组将“BREAKING”和“BARRIERS”理解为横跨大型对角成分,并在泡沫图上将“LO”和“VE”分开。 承认这些地区需要容忍不规则的基线、非统一格言形状和相互竞争的装饰轮廓。 比较还显示了注解颗粒性:“LO”和“VE”可分为两个空间文本组,或根据协议合并为“LOVE”。 强烈的视觉-语言理解有助于将不寻常的字母形式与连贯的文本联系起来,而本地化则保留了证据发生之处. 这个例子支持定性能力讨论,而不是声称艺术阅读是专属于某个模范家庭的。

blocks.en: Figure 20 : OCR of multilingual packaging and numerical fields.
blocks.zh: 图20:多语种包装和数字字段的OCR。

blocks.en: Figure 20 combines Dutch prose, compact numerical columns, units, percentages, barcode digits, and graphic symbols. The displayed Ours regions retain line-level text and separate numerical entries, whereas comparison panels show alternative fragmentation and transcription errors. This example requires preserving punctuation and units while distinguishing text from nearby logos and illustrations. The challenge is not only recognizing a language but maintaining the spatial associations between heterogeneous textual elements in a crowded package layout.
blocks.zh: 图20合并 荷兰文、紧凑数字列、单位、百分比、条码数字和图形符号。 显示的 Ours 区域保留了行级文本和单独的数字条目,而比较面板则显示其他零碎和抄录错误。 这个例子要求保留标点和单位,同时区分文字与附近的标志和插图. 挑战不仅在于承认一种语言,而且在于在拥挤的一揽子布局中保持不同文字要素之间的空间联系。

blocks.en: 14.8 Visual-Prompt Grounding
blocks.zh: 14.8 视速地面

blocks.en: Figure 21 : Exemplar-guided grounding of densely stacked pipe openings.
blocks.zh: 图21:高叠管开口的模范制导地面。

blocks.en: Figure 21 supplies a visual exemplar of a pipe opening in a tightly packed bundle. The desired unit is an individual opening, rather than the whole stack or the long metal tube extending behind it. The displayed Ours boxes retain this unit across the bundle, while the broad Rex-Omni box illustrates a group-level interpretation. Repeated dark interiors and small boundary gaps make instance separation difficult. The N/A panel is kept as an unavailable comparison and does not support a quantitative baseline claim.
blocks.zh: 图21提供了钢管开口的直观实例,装在一个紧凑的包裹中。 期望的单元是单个开口,而不是整个堆栈或延伸在其后面的长金属管. 显示的 Ours 盒在捆绑处保留了这个单位,而宽的 Rex-Omni 盒则显示了一个组级的解释. 反复出现的黑暗内部和小的边界间隙使得实例分离变得困难. N/A小组作为无法比较的比较加以保留,不支持定量基线索赔。
